svg.title: Run lifecycle
svg.desc: A sequence diagram generated by Archify.

g.data-edge-label: select flows; create split or matrix tasks

g.text: select flows; create split or matrix tasks

g.desc: Use arrow keys to explore relationships. Press Enter or Space to pin details; Escape clears.

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 1 of 9: UI / CLI to FastAPI, POST /runs. Press Enter for details.
g.title: UI / CLI → FastAPI · POST /runs

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 2 of 9: FastAPI to Scheduler + DB, select flows; create split or matrix tasks. Press Enter for details.
g.title: FastAPI → Scheduler + DB · select flows; create split or matrix tasks

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 3 of 9: Agent to Scheduler + DB, claim matching task. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Agent → Scheduler + DB · claim matching task

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 4 of 9: Scheduler + DB to Agent, task + device. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Scheduler + DB → Agent · task + device

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 5 of 9: Agent to Maestro, execute flow with timeout. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Agent → Maestro · execute flow with timeout

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 6 of 9: Maestro to Agent, exit + JUnit. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Maestro → Agent · exit + JUnit

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 7 of 9: Agent to Scheduler + DB, save status and artifact paths. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Agent → Scheduler + DB · save status and artifact paths

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 8 of 9: UI / CLI to FastAPI, GET /runs/{id}/junit. Press Enter for details.
g.title: UI / CLI → FastAPI · GET /runs/{id}/junit

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 9 of 9: FastAPI to UI / CLI, merged JUnit + run detail. Press Enter for details.
g.title: FastAPI → UI / CLI · merged JUnit + run detail

g.title: FastAPI · run routes · Sequence participant
